content: Hi, I changed my mind about my kurta and would like to know whether I can return it. Could you please check the return options for me?

I can check that for you. Please share your user ID and either your registered email or phone number, plus the order ID if you have it.

For a change-of-mind return, the kurta must be unused and within 10 calendar days of delivery. A ₹99 pickup fee is deducted from the item value, and shipping isn’t refunded. Has the kurta been used?
No, the kurta has not been worn or used. My user ID is U022 and my registered email is customer022@example.com.

I found your **Cotton kurta in order O0015**, delivered on **4 September 2026**.

Clothing has a 10-day return window, with delivery counted as day 0. Your return window ended on **14 September**; today, 15 September, is day 11.

I’m sorry, but the kurta is no longer eligible for a change-of-mind return, even though it’s unused. No return has been created.
I understand. Is there any exception or alternative you can offer for returning the unused kurta?

The policy doesn’t provide an exception or another return option for an unused kurta after the 10-day window. I’ll escalate your exception request to a human support agent for review, but I can’t guarantee approval.
